verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS browser platform with SDKs and a CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry settings, opt-out flags, or disabling usage tracking. The observability features (logs, live view, session replay) are customer-facing session monitoring, not vendor telemetry controls, so they do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
